binding.note: This revision freezes the exact source recheck before the next immutable release. Browser acceptance is intentionally not claimed.

method.structural: Parsed all 43 models and their effective variant graphs; checked edge endpoints, lane occupancy, representation, authored ellipses, option-length ratios, concept provenance, source identifiers, and repair targets.
method.semantic: Rechecked every original finding against the authored cases, relations, nodes, states, checks, and changed cases; additionally challenged pre-prediction disclosure under the announced runtime visibility rule.
method.limits: No integrated browser recheck is bound here because the immutable release containing these bytes had not yet been generated.

originalFindingDispositions.evidence: Zero active-edge occurrences omit an endpoint from activeNodeIds across all base and variant states.
The transit model now names publisher, altered arrival update, rider consequence, integrity requirement, and evidence; prediction directly keys integrity with a five-minute detection requirement.

Numeric recovery-timeline data and the missing RPO marker are present, but node `interruption` still omits recovery-point-objective/rpo even though it terminates the RPO look-back interval. The review explicitly required both interruption and last-recoverable points to carry the RPO binding.
Clark–Wilson is now the main worked case with entry clerk, certified entry/release TPs, CDI, independent approver, IVP, and audit evidence; other models moved to an explicit comparison variant.
No D1–D4 model uses sequence representation; both cited models now use boundary representations with persistent case entities and dependency/flow relations.

All seven transfer cases were rewritten to remain within their base systems: upload validation, edge update/device trust, cloud deployment authority, firmware/support identity, database replication, NAC posture, and vendor maintenance closure. Separate variant graphs are unnecessary for those retained entities.
Every declared lane has members, and the eight cited models now place actor/input, control, protected outcome, and evidence entities in lanes whose rules match their semantics.
No authored D1–D4 model contains a literal ellipsis character.
No correct choice is 1.4 times or more the mean distractor length in the authored prediction, transfer, or retry checks.
Every main teaching node in all 43 models now has at least one canonical conceptId.

Template prose remains at 359 exact JSON paths across 42 models: 277 `This element` placeholders, 36 `case effect:` markers, 35 `result:` markers, and 29 malformed-grammar hits. The exact path list is embedded in finding ID14-R2-001.

newFindings.title: Template-generated node and status prose remains systemic
newFindings.observed: The source still exposes placeholders and mechanically concatenated relations rather than case-authored explanations. Examples include `This element are recorded in asset inventory`, `case effect:`, `result:`, and label chains such as `Identity And Posture Evidence inform allow, restrict or quarantine NAC Decision`.
newFindings.expected: Every node detail and visible status is a short natural sentence about the case entity or outcome, with no template markers, placeholder subject, or label concatenation.

newFindings.title: Neutral pre-prediction entity labels reveal keyed answers
newFindings.observed: The announced pre-prediction gate hides captions, statuses, edges, details, and focal conclusions but retains entity labels. In these models the labels themselves name the correct decision, property, role, or lifecycle. `d1-o01` visibly includes `Decline and preserve` and `Authorized escalation`; `d1-o02` includes `Integrity requirement`; `d1-o06` includes `Security Standard` and `Policy Exception`.
newFindings.expected: Before prediction, visible labels identify concrete case actors/resources without naming the property or action the learner must select. The concept/decision label appears only after commitment.

cases.predictionPrompt: What should Maya do before the launch report is finalized?
cases.keyedAnswer: Decline the alteration, preserve the evidence, and use the authorized escalation channel

cases.predictionPrompt: The public page remains reachable and discloses no sensitive data, but an attacker changes arrival times. Which property failed, and which requirement tests the fix?
cases.keyedAnswer: Integrity failed; permit only authorized updates and detect unauthorized changes within five minutes.

cases.predictionPrompt: Who may direct, analyze, operate, assure, and accept an urgent acquisition exception, and what evidence crosses each role boundary?
cases.keyedAnswer: The authorized business owner accepts or treats the residual risk after receiving scoped analysis and assurance evidence.

cases.predictionPrompt: Where should a remote-administration rule live, and how can a temporary variance remain subordinate, bounded, and reviewable?
cases.keyedAnswer: Put the measurable minimum in a standard and treat any variance as a scoped, owned, expiring exception.

cases.predictionPrompt: Why must a pseudonymized export, join key, API token, backups, and derived sets remain visible before an owner assigns protection requirements?
cases.keyedAnswer: Inventory the full asset and copy context, then let the accountable owner choose scheme-specific protection requirements.

cases.predictionPrompt: Who validates and authorizes each step from upload event to function, container, and protected object, and who may change that path?
cases.keyedAnswer: Authorize each event and object at enforcement; govern deployment authority separately.

cases.predictionPrompt: Which security decision and evidence artifact must survive when an old portal is replaced, changed, and retired?
cases.keyedAnswer: Trace needs through acceptance, operations, change, and verified retirement.

nextReview: Recompute the aggregate after remediation, verify all exact source paths, then bind a full wrong-answer → targeted-repair → changed-transfer → reload → review journey in one unit per domain to the new immutable release.
